description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198 with the mesh refinement around the fish (one level, zone G 12 0.1, regrid every 2 steps) and subcycling (G 7 1): the finest level predicts, the fish is fitted to the predicted velocity of all its patches (cfd_amr::body_fit) and advanced, then the patches are forced (momentum_rk::amr_forcing); the discrete recoil correction (X 196 2) from the patches.
covers: amr_save/amr_restore of the discrete recoil correction
